author: pgaudet
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete 
GO:0010142 farnesyl diphosphate biosynthetic process, mevalonate pathway and GO:1902767 isoprenoid biosynthetic process via mevalonate, see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32082

There are 23 annotations, see 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1tlPOGCB06u3ZpeH6TC0OLXVqZQFbY0dFOKx57M9K1YE/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Consider: GO:0019287 isopentenyl diphosphate biosynthetic process, mevalonate pathway or 'GO:0045337 trans, trans-farnesyl diphosphate biosynthetic process' 


assigned_by | Count
EcoCyc | 1
GeneDB | 1
MGI | 26
~PomBase | 8~
SGD | 2
UniProt | 2 (deleted) 

There is one InterPro mapping: InterPro:IPR013746 Hydroxymethylglutaryl-coenzyme A synthase, C-terminal domain > GO:farnesyl diphosphate biosynthetic process, mevalonate pathway ; GO:0010142


Thanks, Pascale
title: Review annotations to GO:0010142 farnesyl diphosphate biosynthetic process, mevalonate pathway and GO:1902767 isoprenoid biosynthetic process via mevalonate.
